name: Window Controls
description: Focus, snap, minimize and move windows across monitors.

intents.name: focus_window
intents.description: Bring a window to the foreground by title or process name

name.description: Window title or process name fragment

intents.name: snap_left
intents.description: Snap the active (or named) window to the left half of the monitor

intents.name: snap_right
intents.description: Snap the active (or named) window to the right half of the monitor

intents.name: maximize_window
intents.description: Maximize the active or named window

intents.name: minimize_window
intents.description: Minimize the active or named window

intents.name: minimize_others
intents.description: Minimize every window except the active one

intents.name: move_to_next_monitor
intents.description: Move the active window to the next monitor
